summary: Iteration 2 retest of the 15 fixes from iteration 1, plus a quick regression. Backend: 36 pytest tests (25 old + 11 new), 35 pass when run one at a time. The 1 failure is new: price 'nan' or 'inf' returns 500 and also saves a broken course. Frontend: 14 of 15 fixes verified in the UI. Fix (12) is only partly done, because StudentAttendance.jsx still shows fake fallback numbers. Regression flows all pass.

critical.issue: num() accepts float('nan') and float('inf'). Price 'nan' or 'inf' returns 500 AND inserts the course before JSON encoding fails. After that, GET /api/courses/all returns 500 for the instructor and admin until the record is removed by hand (reproduced: all:500, then 200 after cleanup). If such a course is published (status:'published' in the body), the public GET /api/courses would also 500. Fix: in num(), reject values where math.isfinite(out) is False with a 400. The same applies to totalMarks and maxMarks.

minor.issue: float(body['progress']) is not validated, so 'abc' gives 500. Use num().

assignment_graded (marks and feedback), result_published (grades) and new_submission are still sent to every socket. Only 'notification' is room-scoped. Any logged-in client can read other students' grades.

The lockout key is the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. Sending a new spoofed XFF on each try gets around the lockout. Consider keying on email alone, or on the last trusted proxy hop.
Not scoped for instructors: an instructor can list enrolments (with student names) for other instructors' courses.
Does not check that the student is enrolled in the course.
When admin passes instructorId, instructorName and instructorAvatar are still set from the admin user.

ui_bugs.issue: Fix (12) is incomplete. A freshly registered student with 0 sessions sees PRESENT DAYS 3 and LATE/ABSENT 1/0. Cause: the fallbacks `studentStats.presentCount || 3`, `lateCount || 1` and `attendanceRate || 88` (a real 0% would show as 88%), plus a fake default list for history at line 16. Remove these fallbacks.
When POST /discussions fails (for example 403), the message is still added to the list on screen as if it was sent. The user gets no error. Show a toast error instead.
Falls back to a fake enrolment {id:'demo_enrol', progress:50} when the student is not enrolled.

integration_issues.issue: The export files are hardcoded static strings (5 seeded users), not live data. Overview revenue CSV uses the mocked stats, which is expected.

resultsSlice initialState.totalGradedCourses is still 2. The 'user_student_1' default arguments are still there in fetchResults and fetchEnrolments, and InstructorResults defaults selectedStudentId to 'user_student_1'.

issues: Session Date is still a native <input type=date>, not the shadcn calendar
A course with 0 enrolled students shows an empty table with no empty-state message, and the Submit button is still enabled
Still use the old rounded-card slate styling, which does not match the editorial redesign used on the other pages
Section eyebrow 'CHAPTER II' (Featured) comes before 'CHAPTER I'
Revenue and enrolments share one colour and one Y axis, so the enrolments line looks flat at 0
The main button says 'Publish Course' even when the status toggle is Draft

regression: PASS: demo sign-in for all 3 roles; catalogue search, category and sort; signed-out enrol redirects to /sign-in; course player discussion (an instructor API post appears live, and the student's own UI message appears once); instructor creates a Draft course, which appears in My courses and is hidden from the catalogue; admin Overview CSV and Reports CSV download; at 390px the navbar menu and dashboard sidebar open with no horizontal overflow.
action_items: HIGH: In num(), reject non-finite values (math.isfinite) with a 400, so 'nan'/'inf' are neither saved nor returned as 500
HIGH: Remove the fake fallbacks in StudentAttendance.jsx (|| 3, || 1, || 88, default history list)
Remove resultsSlice totalGradedCourses:2 and the 'user_student_1' defaults (resultsSlice, enrolmentsSlice, InstructorResults)
CoursePlayer: show an error toast instead of adding the message on screen when POST /discussions fails
Send assignment_graded and result_published only to the student's room
Replace the native date input in InstructorAttendance with the shadcn calendar; add an empty state for a roster with 0 students
critical_code_review_comments: num(): NaN and Infinity get through, and insert() runs before the response is encoded, so bad data is saved
Grade data is broadcast to every socket (assignment_graded, result_published)
The X-Forwarded-For based lockout can be bypassed by spoofing the header
AdminReports export data is hardcoded and does not reflect the DB

Auth uses Bearer tokens in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies. CORS is '*' with allow_credentials=False, which is consistent with that design. bcrypt hashes start with $2b$ (verified). seed() runs only when the users collection is empty, so it never resets the admin password
seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_ users, courses, assignments, submissions, discussions and notifications were cleaned up, and login_attempts was cleared.
flaky_tests: When pytest runs with xdist in parallel (the pytest.ini default), test_courses_all_scoping and test_full_flow failed once with a non-JSON response, and test_discussions failed because of ordering when another worker posted at the same moment. All pass with -n 0. Run the suite serially: pytest tests/ -n 0
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests -n 0 (takes about 2.5 min). The socket test uses python-socketio with polling transport (websocket-client is not installed). Toasts have no data-testid, so match them by text. CoursePlayer and InstructorAttendance have few testids. Clear login_attempts after running the lockout test.
